title: Software Engineer
description: Design, develop, and maintain software systems and applications across various domains including web, mobile, and enterprise systems.
responsibilities: Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code
Review code and mentor junior developers
future_scope: High demand across all industries. Specializations in AI/ML, cloud, and distributed systems command premium salaries. Career path leads to Senior Engineer, Staff Engineer, or Engineering Manager.

title: Data Scientist
description: Extract insights from large datasets using statistical analysis, machine learning, and data visualization to drive business decisions.
responsibilities: Build and validate machine learning models
Create data pipelines and ETL processes
future_scope: Explosive growth with AI adoption. Specializations in NLP, computer vision, and ML ops are especially valuable. Career leads to Senior Data Scientist, ML Engineer, or Chief Data Officer.

title: Frontend Developer
description: Build user interfaces and interactive web experiences using modern frameworks, ensuring performance, accessibility, and great UX.
responsibilities: Develop responsive and accessible UI components
Collaborate with designers and UX teams
Optimize web performance and Core Web Vitals
future_scope: Strong demand. Full-stack transition is common. React Native enables mobile development. Web3 and WebAssembly are emerging specializations.

title: Backend Developer
description: Build scalable server-side applications, APIs, and database systems that power web and mobile applications.
responsibilities: Design and build RESTful or GraphQL APIs
Optimize database queries and schema design
future_scope: Foundation of all tech products. Microservices, serverless, and event-driven architectures are key growth areas. Leads to Full Stack, System Architect, or CTO roles.

title: DevOps / Platform Engineer
description: Bridge development and operations by automating deployment pipelines, managing cloud infrastructure, and ensuring system reliability.
responsibilities: Implement monitoring, alerting, and incident response
future_scope: Critical for all tech companies. Platform Engineering and SRE are high-growth specializations. Cloud certifications (AWS, GCP, Azure) significantly boost salary.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description: Build production ML systems at scale — from data pipelines to model deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
responsibilities: Design and train ML models for production
Build scalable data and feature pipelines
Deploy and monitor models in production
Collaborate with data scientists and engineers
future_scope: One of the fastest-growing and highest-paid roles in tech. LLM fine-tuning, RAG systems, and AI infrastructure are frontier areas with massive demand.

title: Data Analyst
description: Collect, clean, and interpret data to provide actionable business insights through reports, dashboards, and statistical analysis.
future_scope: Strong entry point into data careers. Natural progression to Data Scientist, Analytics Engineer, or Business Intelligence Engineer. SQL and visualization skills are enduring assets.

title: Cybersecurity Analyst
description: Protect organizations from cyber threats through continuous monitoring, incident response, vulnerability assessment, and security architecture.
future_scope: Severe talent shortage globally. Certifications (CISSP, CEH, OSCP) dramatically increase earning potential. Cloud security and zero-trust architecture are top specializations.

title: Cloud Architect
description: Design scalable, secure, and cost-effective cloud infrastructure solutions across AWS, GCP, or Azure for enterprise applications.
responsibilities: Design cloud-native architecture for new systems
Advise engineering teams on cloud best practices
future_scope: Extremely high demand as enterprises migrate to cloud. Multi-cloud expertise and FinOps knowledge are premium skills. Leads to CTO or VP of Engineering roles.

title: Product Manager
description: Define product vision, strategy, and roadmap, working at the intersection of business, technology, and user experience.
responsibilities: Prioritize features using data and user feedback
Collaborate with engineering, design, and marketing
future_scope: Critical role in all tech companies. Technical PMs with engineering background command highest salaries. Career leads to VP of Product or Chief Product Officer.

title: UX/UI Designer
description: Create intuitive, accessible, and beautiful user experiences through research, wireframing, prototyping, and visual design.
responsibilities: Conduct user interviews and usability tests
Create wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs
Collaborate closely with product and engineering
Iterate based on user feedback and data
future_scope: Growing importance as product quality becomes a competitive differentiator. UX writing, motion design, and AI-assisted design tools are emerging skills.

title: Full Stack Developer
description: Build complete web applications from database to user interface, working across the entire technology stack.
responsibilities: Build end-to-end features across frontend and backend
Write tests across the full stack
future_scope: Highly versatile role valued by startups and growth-stage companies. Can specialize into senior frontend, backend, or architect tracks. Next.js and serverless are strong growth areas.

title: Site Reliability Engineer (SRE)
description: Ensure production systems are reliable, scalable, and efficient by applying software engineering principles to operations problems.
responsibilities: Define and maintain SLOs, SLIs, and error budgets
Lead incident response and post-mortem processes
Partner with dev teams on reliability practices
future_scope: One of the highest-paid engineering specializations at top tech companies. Chaos engineering, observability, and multi-region reliability are key growth areas.

title: Data Engineer
description: Design and build the data infrastructure, pipelines, and warehouses that enable data science and business intelligence teams.
responsibilities: Build and maintain data pipelines at scale
Collaborate with data scientists on feature engineering
future_scope: Critical enabler of all data-driven decisions. Lakehouse architectures, real-time analytics, and AI/ML data platforms are high-growth areas.

title: Mobile App Developer
description: Build native or cross-platform mobile applications for iOS and Android with smooth UX and robust performance.
responsibilities: Develop native iOS or Android features
Build cross-platform apps with React Native or Flutter
Integrate REST APIs and push notifications
Optimize app performance and battery usage
Submit and manage apps on App Store / Play Store
Write UI tests and automated test suites
future_scope: Mobile remains the primary interface for billions of users. Wearables, AR/VR apps, and on-device AI are emerging frontiers for mobile developers.

title: Blockchain Developer
description: Build decentralized applications, smart contracts, and blockchain infrastructure for Web3, DeFi, and enterprise use cases.
responsibilities: Write and audit smart contracts in Solidity
Build dApps and integrate with wallets
future_scope: Highly specialized with strong demand in Web3, DeFi, and enterprise blockchain. Security auditing expertise commands exceptional rates.

title: AI/LLM Engineer
description: Build AI-powered products using large language models, fine-tuning, RAG systems, and AI infrastructure for production deployment.
responsibilities: Build RAG systems and AI pipelines
Monitor AI system quality and safety
Stay current with rapidly evolving AI landscape
future_scope: The hottest engineering discipline in 2024–2026. Comprehensive AI knowledge accelerates every adjacent career. Demand far exceeds supply globally.
